basis: Applied the frozen rules in event-semantic-adjudication.md to the Chinese event_text and event_code in all 18 completed answers and controls JSON files. Recorded exclusions only. Explicit possible predictions of a concrete event were retained regardless of cautious wording; money changes were treated broadly; job_change required an explicit job/position/unit/team/workplace or career-direction change, while duties/workstyle/redivision/collaboration-only changes were excluded. Case IDs and event text were cross-checked against source records.
limitations: This is a Luna proxy text audit, not an independent human review. No life answers, scores, reports, research, datasets/gold, charts, probes, or other agents’ files were consulted; superseded prior liuyao/qimen answers were not read.
